dedupe_keys.name: otwarte dane transportowe odt catalogue of gtfs gtfs rt and netex feeds in poland

description: Otwarte Dane Transportowe (Open Transport Data, ODT) is a volunteer-run catalogue of public transport data published by operators and authorities across Poland. For each organisation it lists the region and direct links to static feeds and real-time feeds, and the project supports GTFS, GTFS-RT, NeTEx, SIRI and GBFS. The list includes city transport authorities such as Warsaw, Kraków, Poznań, Gdańsk, Szczecin and the Upper Silesian-Zagłębie metropolis, regional railways such as Koleje Dolnośląskie, Koleje Małopolskie and Łódzka Kolej Aglomeracyjna, POLREGIO and bus operators. It is run by Jakub Zydroń, and the site also tracks cases of requests for access to data under the Polish open data act of 11 August 2021. Coverage is national (Poland). Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MIT for the ODT catalogue; feeds keep their operators' terms. Caveats: it is a community project, feed coverage is partial and real-time feeds exist for only some operators. It supports public transit network models, accessibility and disruption analysis with timetables. It complements the GTFS specification and is related to the Riga public transport real-time data.
